tasks.AdditionalDistanceCalculation: Calculate the additional distance that can be traveled with the remaining money at a rate of 10 cents per quarter-mile.
tasks.InitialCostCalculation: Calculate the initial cost of the cab ride.
tasks.RemainingMoneyCalculation: Calculate the remaining money after accounting for the initial cost.
tasks.TotalDistanceCalculation: Sum up the initial quarter-mile and the additional distance to get the total distance.
